usage: 金 (gam1) is a noun referring to the metal gold.
It can be used to talk about the material gold or objects made from gold.
金 is often used as a symbol of wealth or value in everyday speech.
You can combine 金 with other words to form compound nouns, like 金飾 (gold jewelry).
In Cantonese, the word 金 does not change form based on tense or number.
